title: MARS: Training Multilingual Search Agents for Retriever-Free Evidence Acquisition
abstract: arXiv:2611.09090v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing multilingual retrieval-augmented generation relies heavily on learned retrievers and similarity-based ranking from multilingual collections, which are vulnerable to cross-lingual retrieval errors and indexing overhead. In this paper, we explore retriever-free multilingual search, where the model directly interacts with raw corpora through executable shell commands. This paradigm shifts the bottleneck to multilingual search action generation, where exact search is sensitive to entity surface forms and outcome-only supervision provides limited guidance for multi-turn search. To address these challenges, we propose MARS, a multilingual search agent in direct corpus interaction (DCI) with reinforcement learning (RL). MARS introduces corpus-native entity grounding to recover reliable lexical anchors from corpus evidence, mitigating failure to retrieve evidence. translated_title: MARS：训练多语言搜索智能体以实现无检索器的证据获取
translated_abstract: 现有的多语言检索增强生成严重依赖于从多语言文献集合中学习到的检索器以及基于相似度的排序，这种方式容易受到跨语言检索错误和索引开销的影响。在本文中，我们探索了无检索器的多语言搜索，即模型通过可执行的 shell 命令直接与原始语料库交互。这一范式将瓶颈转移到了多语言搜索动作的生成上：精确搜索对实体的表层形式非常敏感，而仅基于结果的监督为多轮搜索提供的引导十分有限。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 MARS——一个在直接语料库交互（DCI）范式下通过强化学习（RL）训练的多语言搜索智能体。MARS 引入了语料库原生的实体锚定方法，从语料库证据中恢复可靠的词汇锚点，从而缓解证据检索失败的问题。同时，我们提出了一种冗余感知的搜索奖励，以鼓励简洁……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MARS——一个通过强化学习训练的多语言搜索智能体，让模型直接与原始语料库交互而无需传统检索器，并借助语料库原生的实体锚定和冗余感知的搜索奖励机制来克服跨语言精确搜索的困难、实现高效证据获取。
en_tdlr: MARS is a multilingual search agent trained with reinforcement learning to directly interact with raw corpora without a retriever, using corpus-native entity grounding and a redundancy-aware search reward to overcome cross-lingual exact-search challenges and achieve effective evidence acquisition.
